verificationSummary: Editor commit 24219dc0d6e5ec79368c82b159b37e3f9a0b9ed5 defines a tested memory-only active text-block island runtime state. It adds src/editor/draft/activeTextBlockIsland.ts, src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts, and updates docs/TEXT_BLOCK_AUTHORING_BOUNDARY.md. The runtime opens one active text-block draft at a time through the text-block authoring boundary, clones rich-inline children into browser-local draft state, tracks the Core base revision and local draft revision, tracks IME composition state, blocks commit while IME composition is active, validates rich-inline payloads through the Core adapter before building a Backend text-block.rich-inline.replace request, blocks commit when the opened base revision no longer matches the current Core document revision, and records rejected commit evidence without discarding a newer local draft. The accepted RED was npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts failing because ../editor/draft/activeTextBlockIsland was missing. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts src/tests/boundary.test.ts with 3 test files and 11 tests. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 92 test files with 319 tests, and build; merged Editor main npm run check passed the same gate. This evidence does not enable visible text input, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, field-chip input, rich-inline flattening, React canvas input binding, collaboration, durable draft persistence, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, large-document authoring performance, accessibility readiness, exact layout, export parity, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. npm ci reported 5 existing high severity audit findings and Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning; neither was remediated in this lane. The feature worktree C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-ati-0830 was intentionally retained because previous Editor worktree cleanup exposed dependency-link side effects that deleted Core tracked files under packages/text-engine-rust-wasm. The older residual folder C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-editor-tb-20260830 remains on disk and is still tracked as cleanup risk.
